data.narrative:
Aepnus Technology is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Lukas Hackl and Bilen Akuzum. The target operates within a sector represented by one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

The valuation analysis employs a Stage-Progression methodology, the only applicable triangulation approach given data constraints. Using total capital raised of $10.6M as a proxy for seed-stage value, a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $26.5M. This multiplier reflects normalized expansion capital and dilution patterns observed across comparable seed-stage climate and energy companies. The peer-median method proved inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow climate and energy cohort—fewer than three datapoints met filtering criteria—making a sector-wide median unreliable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $23M to $30M, with a median of $26M. This narrow band reflects reliance on a single methodological input rather than triangulation across multiple approaches. Key uncertainties include the absence of sufficient same-stage peer multiples, which limits confidence in the 2.5x step-up assumption for Aepnus specifically, and the limited public market depth in frontier climate technology. Additional revenue or customer metrics, if available, would better ground the valuation beyond capital-raised proxies.
